title: Authentication Guide
text: API keys recommended method programmatic access. base64-encoded credentials can generated PetroVisor web interface.
code: # Authenticate using an API key token_response <- auth_service$get_access_token(   key = "your_api_key_here",   discovery_url = "https://identity.us1.petrovisor.com" )  # The response contains: # - access_token: The token to use for API requests # - token_type: Usually "Bearer" # - expires_in: Token lifetime in seconds # - refresh_token: Token for refreshing access  access_token <- token_response$access_token refresh_token <- token_response$refresh_token

title: Authentication Guide
text: API keys base64-encoded strings containing username password information. AuthenticationService automatically: Decodes API key Extracts credentials Obtains access token identity server Returns token response

title: Authentication Guide
text: don’t API key, can authenticate directly credentials: Security Note: Avoid hardcoding credentials scripts. Use environment variables secure configuration files instead.
code: token_response <- auth_service$get_access_token(   username = "your_username",   password = "your_password",   discovery_url = "https://identity.us1.petrovisor.com" )  access_token <- token_response$access_token # Store credentials in environment variables username <- Sys.getenv("PETROVISOR_USER") password <- Sys.getenv("PETROVISOR_PASSWORD") discovery_url <- Sys.getenv("PETROVISOR_URL")  token_response <- auth_service$get_access_token(   username = username,   password = password,   discovery_url = discovery_url )

title: Authentication Guide
text: Access tokens expire certain period (typically 1 hour). Use refresh tokens obtain new access tokens without re-entering credentials:
code: # Use a refresh token to get a new access token token_response <- auth_service$get_access_token(   refresh_token = refresh_token,   discovery_url = "https://identity.us1.petrovisor.com" )  # Update your access token access_token <- token_response$access_token  # You'll also get a new refresh token refresh_token <- token_response$refresh_token

text: Never hardcode tokens scripts:

title: Authentication Guide
text: Access tokens expire. Implement refresh logic:
code: # Store both access and refresh tokens tokens <- list(   access = token_response$access_token,   refresh = token_response$refresh_token,   expires_at = Sys.time() + token_response$expires_in )  # Check expiration before API calls check_token <- function(tokens, discovery_url) {   if (Sys.time() >= tokens$expires_at) {     # Token expired, refresh it     auth_service <- AuthenticationService$new()     new_response <- auth_service$get_access_token(       refresh_token = tokens$refresh,       discovery_url = discovery_url     )      tokens$access <- new_response$access_token     tokens$refresh <- new_response$refresh_token     tokens$expires_at <- Sys.time() + new_response$expires_in   }    return(tokens) }
